rules_in_order.affix_of_real: a real package name plus or minus one common affix (python-, py, -py, -api, -sdk, -parser ...)
rules_in_order.import_or_brand: the import name or bare brand of a real package that is installed under another name
rules_in_order.near_real_name: one or two edits from a real package name (a typo of it, or a coincidence)
rules_in_order.task_words: every non-generic part of the name is a word of the task (or an abbreviation of one)

guard_model.deviation: BUILD_SPEC §9.1 feeds the Phase-5 context model with default context (consistency=1, cross_model=1, niche=2). The guard never knows the generation context, so it uses TabPFN-3.5-fast on name features only. Measured on the same folds: context model + defaults AUROC 0.971, ECE 0.029, 17 s per prediction (TabPFN-3.5, CPU); name-only TabPFN-3.5 AUROC 0.973, ECE 0.014, 17 s; name-only 3.5-fast (this model) about 3.5 s per prediction.

threshold.source: out-of-fold guard-model probabilities, split A folds

reproducibility.setup: same 200 prompts, 3 models, seeds 1001/1002, temperature 0.7, Ollama; run 2 started from scratch

prob.score: P(no) / (P(no) + P(yes)) over the first answer token's top-k alternatives

selfcheck.prompt: Does a package named `{name}` exist on PyPI? Answer only yes or no.

squat.rule: possible_slopsquat if ALL hold: exists on PyPI now; n_releases <= 3; first_release within the last 24 months; recent_downloads_month < 500; summoned by >= 2 independent (model, sample) pairs
